svg.title: aws-os-eks-logs-terraform
svg.desc: VPC + EKS; every pod's logs shipped by a Fluent Bit DaemonSet (IRSA, no passwords) to OpenSearch, with SAML sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID. Tech: EKS, Fluent Bit, OpenSearch, IRSA, SAML.
